创建账号，加入你的跑团: Create an account and join your game
登录账号，继续你的故事: Sign in and continue your story
登录状态安全保存在此设备，退出登录后清除。: Your session is stored securely on this device and cleared when you sign out.
用户名为 3–32 位字母、数字、下划线、点或短横线；密码至少 6 位。: Use 3–32 letters, digits, underscores, dots or hyphens. Passwords need at least 6 characters.
从侧栏选择频道和聊天窗口: Pick a server and channel, or create one from the left.
选择一个频道开始聊天: Pick a server and channel, or create one from the left.
创建后可继续编辑属性、技能、背景和外观。: After creating a character you can edit attributes, skills, background and images.
创建后你将成为此频道的守密人，并自动建立主聊天窗口。: You become this channel's GM and a main chat window is created automatically.
向成员显示日志制作: Log Studio available in this channel
根据叙述建议新阶段: Suggest new scenarios from the narration
以下设置仅作用于当前频道: These settings apply only to this channel.
公开模式会让角色共享频道知识；隔离模式按角色可见范围提供线索。: Public mode shares channel knowledge; isolated mode uses each character's visible knowledge.
仅服务器管理员可访问: Only server maintainers can change these settings.
仅当前频道的 GM 可访问: Only this channel's GM can access these settings.
普通守密人可邀请已有服务器成员，服务器管理员还可邀请其他已注册用户。: Keepers can invite server members; server maintainers can also invite other registered users.
生成头像与主立绘: Generate portrait, avatar and the chosen subtitles
选择职业: Choose a career from the list
添加专长或自定义技能: Add a specialisation or custom skill, e.g. Science (Biology)
职业规则暂不可用，请重试；草稿保留: Rules unavailable. Retry; your draft is kept.
特长使用下方技能名，可填专长如 Science (Biology)。: Add a specialisation or custom skill, e.g. Science (Biology)
总值 = 基础 + 成长 + 职业 + 兴趣。这里显示预览，保存时由服务器重新校: Total = base + growth + career + hobby. The server validates the allocation when saved.
暂时没有需要提醒的内容: Nothing to remind you of yet.
开启下一阶段: Open the next scenario for the whole campaign
进入后，所有聊天窗口一起切换，当前阶段将关闭: All chat windows enter the new scenario and the current scenario closes.
所有聊天窗口将进入下一阶段: All chat windows enter the new scenario and the current scenario closes.
开启后，所有聊天窗口一起进入新阶段，上一阶段关闭并生成摘要。: All chat windows enter the new scenario and the current scenario closes.
日志制作已被服务器管理员或 GM 关闭: The Keeper has hidden the Log Studio in this channel.
暂无可回放内容: No visible lines in this presentation.
暂无 PDF，请先在 Log Studio 完成排版与渲染: No PDF yet. Render one in the web Log Studio.
同意将选定日志发送至配置的云端服务: Send these lines to the configured model
允许本次生成使用云端服务: Send these lines to the configured model
此段暂无已生成配音: No voice generated for this line.
示例服务，无真实配音费用: MOCK TTS — synthetic tones, not speech
允许日志制作使用云端处理: Allow cloud processing for this campaign
将使用服务器配置的配音服务，可能产生费用；实际金额由服务商结算。: The configured voice service may charge fees. The provider determines the actual cost.
日志加载失败，请重试: Could not load the log. Please retry.
登录已过期，请重新登录: Session expired. Please sign in again.
无法读取已保存的登录，请重新登录: Could not restore your session. Please sign in again.
登录成功，但设备未能安全保存登录状态: Signed in, but this device could not securely save your session.
设备未能清除登录记录，请保持联网完成退出: Could not clear the saved session. Stay connected to finish signing out.
命令预览不可用；发送时由服务器校验: Preview unavailable. The server will validate the command when sent.
角色资料加载失败，请重新打开角色卡: Could not load the character. Please open it again.
聊天每 4 秒刷新，服务器与频道列表每 30 秒同步，回到前台立即更新。: Chat refreshes every 4 seconds, server and channel lists every 30 seconds, and immediately on returning to the app.
日志操作失败，请重试: Could not load the log. Please retry.
